messages:
Maya Patel: Follow-up from last night's outage affecting auth provider + model registry. I made an action tracker in the postmortem doc: https://docs.internal/redwood/postmortems/INC-4721
Maya Patel: Short-term: auth fallback, model-server local cache. Long-term: cross-region replication + signed manifests. Need owners and dates.
Jordan Lee: I'll take auth fallback. Plan: token cache + circuit breaker behind feature flag. ETA 2026-04-05. Will open PR and post config.
Samir Khan: I'll take model-registry replication. Plan: replicate artifacts to second-region S3 with versioning and signed manifests; add rollback plan. ETA 2026-04-19.
Nina Gomez: I'll own monitoring + runbook updates. Adding alert thresholds, on-call checklist, and playtest steps. ETA 2026-04-12.
infra-bot: Created tasks INC-4721, INC-4722, INC-4723.
Jordan Lee: Staging config snippet:
```yaml
auth_fallback:
  enabled: true
  fallback_provider: internal-token
  cache_ttl_seconds: 600
  circuit_breaker_threshold: 0.05
```
Jordan Lee: Test plan: simulate auth 502s, verify traffic shifts to fallback, ensure 95th percentile latency <200ms.
Samir Khan: Replication quick steps: push artifacts+manifest to s3://redwood-models-replica, enable versioning+SSE, sign manifest with sha256. Short-term enable read-only local cache TTL 24h.
Nina Gomez: Runbook commands: kubectl -n infra rollout restart deploy/model-registry; curl -s https://model-registry.internal/manifest/latest | jq .version. PagerDuty flow P1 -> SRE lead -> Eng oncall -> PM.
Olivia Chen: Finance: will estimate cross-region egress & storage costs; need approval before rollout.
Maya Patel: Weekly sync Tuesdays 10:00am PT starting next week. Owners/dates locked on thread; update INC-472* tickets when done. If delays, annotate in tracker.
Jordan Lee: ACK. Will post PR link when green.
Samir Khan: Opening quota & IAM tickets now.
Nina Gomez: :eyes: Will schedule playtest with SRE.
Olivia Chen: Noted — cost review Friday.
Maya Patel: Thanks all. Keep updates brief in the tracker. :thumbsup:
